name: Agent Guild Passport — offline verification
description: Verify a caller-supplied public Agent Guild Passport offline against the administrator-pinned issuer and an independently known subject DID. Checks signature, identity binding and a 24-hour signed freshness policy. Does not fetch, register, pay, assess safety or authorize hiring. Supply the complete credential JSON text; do not infer the expected subject from it.
author: AgentTanuki

input.hint: Pin the trusted Guild issuer independently of the supplied passport. No automatic issuer discovery or trust-on-first-use.

examples.prompt: Verify this public Agent Passport against the issuer configured by my administrator. I already know the expected subject DID from my task.
examples.call: {"credential_json":"<complete public Agent Passport JSON text>","expected_subject_did":"<independently known subject did:key>"}

credential_json.description: Complete public AgentGuildPassport VC 2.0 JSON text, including every original signed field and proof. Maximum 65,536 UTF-8 bytes. No secrets or private credentials.

expected_subject_did.description: The Ed25519 did:key subject already known independently from this credential. Must match credentialSubject.id exactly; never copy it from the untrusted passport merely to make the check pass.
